subject: [AMBER] pymsmt.exp.pymsmtError: MOL is required in naa_mol2files but not provided.

messages.author: CHENTOUF Sara
messages.body:
Hello,
I tried using the first step of the MSCP.py program and I get an error message:
pymsmt.exp.pymsmtError: MOL is required in naa_mol2files but not provided.
I have checked my files and it looks all the information are given in naa_mol2files.
Any help I could get would be appreciated
Thanks
Sara
